title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing a two-dimensional sketch on a single face. Within this face, draw a single loop and within the loop, draw a circle with its center at coordinates (0.0234, 0.0234) and a radius of 0.0234. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0469 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using the translation vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) to position it correctly. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion forms a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length of 0.046875 units, a width of 0.046875 units, and a height of 0.7500000000000001 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the base cylinder
base_cylinder = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0234, 0.0234)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0234)          # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.75)           # Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
)

# Create the small cylindrical protrusion
protrusion = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0234, 0.0234)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0234)          # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.0469)         # Extrude the circle to create the protrusion
)

# Combine the base cylinder and the protrusion
r = base_cylinder.union(protrusion)

# Display the final model

    workplane
